Endlessly fun.Beachside Circle Boat Rentals and Sales is a local family owned business that loves the water! We offer a fun and unique way to enjoy the waters of Orange Beach. Our portable-eco friendly electric circle boats make it easy for anyone to be a captain! Quiet, clean, and simple to operate, they're perfect for cruising in the no wake zones, fishing through the canals, pull up to one of islands for a relaxing day or stopping at one of the local waterfront restaurants for lunch or appetizers! Its a laid back experience the whole family can enjoy and a memory you'll never forget!Perfect forFamiliesCouplesBirthday PartiesGroup OutingsFishing TripsRelaxing on the WaterNo boating license needed!Step 1 · Pick Your BoatChoose Your RidePick a boat — you'll choose your time and add extras like a cooler at checkout.Single Seater 1 adultSolo cruiser. 57 lbs, portable, 35lb electric motor.
